findings.matched_text: A strong password, reliable spam filtering, and assurance that your inbox isn’t being sold to advertisers might be sufficient.
findings.sentence: A strong password, reliable spam filtering, and assurance that your inbox isn’t being sold to advertisers might be sufficient.
findings.suggestion: Consider naming the concrete properties rather than a string of general qualities.
findings.why: General qualities can leave the reader without a concrete property.
findings.fix: Use actual supported properties, or keep a parallel list if it communicates them.
findings.keep_when: Keep factual triples, intentional rhetoric and technical categories.

findings.suggestion: Check heading case against the venue's style; title case may be required.
findings.why: Heading capitalization may distract if it conflicts with the venue style.
findings.fix: Use the required or established heading style consistently.
findings.keep_when: Keep title case when the publication or naming convention requires it.

findings.suggestion: Use actual headings when they aid navigation; keep compact labels in forms and reference lists.
findings.why: Repeated bold labels may make navigation harder than real headings.
findings.fix: Consider semantic headings where readers need navigation.
findings.keep_when: Keep compact labels in forms, reference lists and venue-required layouts.

findings.suggestion: Check whether connected prose would clarify relationships; retain procedures and factual lists.
findings.why: Many full-sentence list items may hide how the claims connect.
findings.fix: Use prose when relationships matter more than parallel scanning.
findings.keep_when: Keep procedures, factual lists and accessible reference material.

findings.sentence: Gmail, for instance, has robust security measures yet historically scanned emails for ad targeting; in contrast, a privacy-focused provider might promise not to read your emails at all.
findings.why: A familiar general word may hide the action or property intended.
findings.fix: Use the precise term or an ordinary verb if it preserves meaning.
findings.keep_when: Keep technical terms such as robust statistics, quoted language and the author’s intentional voice.
